# Tick and performance pitfalls

Read before writing tick, OnUpdate or save-step code. Work is bounded per tick: use HCWorkBudget, HCSaveScheduler, HCModuleReadiness and HCPerfConfig, register every work slot, never scan a whole collection or print per item on a tick path, and keep file I/O inside the staged writer.

Skill: `hc-perf-tick`. Rule ids come from `tools/validate/enforce_lint.py` and `tools/validate/enforce_perf.py`; each rule or cited comment appears on exactly one card.

## Lint and perf rules

| Rule | What it rejects |
|---|---|
| HC-P001 | unbounded string scan inside a loop without HCTextWindow |
| HC-P004 | nested linear collection scan |
| HC-P005 | per-item Print reachable on a tick path |
| HC-P006 | work slot shared by different owner classes |
| HC-P007 | incomplete work slot registration |
| HC-P010 | raw HCTake bypasses consumer fairness and attribution |
| HC-P011 | unbudgeted loop over a module-owned collection on a tick path, not run through HCBoundedJob |
